supportingSources.label: Kineticist Spirit machine guide and playfield

strategy.overview: Spirit builds toward two- or three-ball Multiball through three lit Capture Holes and the center Stargate. Shoot a lit Capture Hole to lock a ball. Complete the 1-4 spot targets, then shoot the lit green X at the Roundabout to open the Stargate; the lit Ball Save targets can also open it. Shoot through the open Stargate for two-ball Multiball with zero or one ball already captured, or for three-ball Multiball with two captured balls. Filling all three Capture Holes also starts three-ball Multiball.
strategy.simpleOverview: Shoot a lit Capture Hole to lock a ball. Complete the 1-4 spot targets, then shoot the lit green X at the Roundabout to open the Stargate. Shoot the open Stargate for two-ball Multiball with zero or one captured ball, or three-ball Multiball with two captured balls; filling all three Capture Holes also starts three-ball Multiball.
strategy.summary: Take a safe lit Capture Hole first, qualify the Stargate through 1-4 and the green X, then choose a fast two-ball start or wait for two locks and a stronger three-ball start.

quickInfo.name: Open Stargate
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the lit green X at the Roundabout.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the open Stargate or fill all three holes.

steps.text: Shoot whichever unoccupied Capture Hole is lit to lock a ball.
Complete spot targets 1, 2, 3, and 4 to light the green X at the Roundabout.
Shoot the lit green X to open the Stargate, then shoot through the open gate.
Use zero or one captured ball for two-ball Multiball, or arrive with two captured balls for three-ball Multiball; three filled Capture Holes also start three-ball play.

alternatives.title: Three-Capture start
alternatives.when: Use this when two Capture Holes are already occupied and the third is safely lit.

steps.text: Shoot the third lit Capture Hole instead of reopening the Stargate.
All three filled holes immediately begin three-ball Multiball.
Capture two balls in lit holes.
Open and shoot the Stargate, or capture the third ball.

machineSetup: Check Capture Hole memory, Stargate timing, ball-save target behavior, Special and Extra Ball settings, and whether lane progress carries between balls.
Test all three Capture Holes and lamps, spot targets 1-4, Roundabout green X, Stargate motor and switch, both drop banks, top-left rollovers, six flippers, and captive-ball releases.

techniques.name: Flipper Staging
techniques.instruction: Stage the paired flippers so the upper flipper can reach a Capture Hole or Stargate feed without giving up control on the main flipper.

cautions.issue: A drain can empty the captive system and erase the Multiball build.
cautions.response: Prefer the two-ball Stargate start when the third capture is substantially riskier than the open gate.
